description: This Java class defines a 'Role' entity for user roles within a book tracking application. It includes annotations for persistence (JPA), Lombok for boilerplate code reduction, and validation constraints. The class manages role names and overrides equality methods based on the role string.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: Entity class representing a user role in the application, with auto-generated ID and a role name, supporting equality based on role name.

methods.name: Role(@NonNull String role)
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a Role object with a role name.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides the default equality check to compare Role objects based on the role string.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides hashCode to generate hash based on role string.
